history.summary: High-floor (#38) 1,281 sqft double-volume LOFT 2BR+study at Icon, D2 CCR, 99-yr from 2002 (~75 yrs left), offered as an SRI owner-sale opening price of $2.2M / $1,717 psf (auction 23 Sep 2026). The ask sits ABOVE every print its own loft stack has ever lodged ($1,669 psf Aug-24, $1,639 Jun-22, $1,444 Jul-21) in a project whose median psf has slid from $1,915 (2024) to $1,760 (2026 YTD, realsmart) and whose 5-yr resale CAGR is 0.7%. Gross yield ~3.4% on real 1,200-1,300 sqft URA leases ($5,700-7,000/mo, 2025-26) misses the 3.5% crash floor. Loft = thin format (void counted in strata sqft), CCR = weakest forward region, and the unit breaches the OCR/3BR mandate outright.
history.rating_rationale: 1) Not cheap where it matters: $1,717 psf is +3% over the loft stack's last print ($2.138M / $1,669 psf, Aug-24, 31-35 fl) and would be the highest psf ever paid for the 1,281 sqft stack; the 1,050-1,400 band's 24-mo median is $1,670 (2 prints, 1,109-1,119 sqft). There are ZERO 1,200-1,302 sqft prints in the last 24 months, so the format has no live bid. The algo's -16.8% age-adjusted 'discount' vs D2 peers is a CCR-district artefact (band_peer_count 3) and the -5.9% vs URA median is the void: 904-936 sqft 2BRs print $1,890-2,090 psf, the loft prices per void-inflated sqft. 2) Trend is down: project psf 2024 $1,915 -> 2025 $1,800 -> 2026 $1,760; ura 3-yr -6.0%, 5-yr CAGR +0.73%, momentum -0.65; realsmart avg annualized profit 1.1%, REALSCORE 2.2 on 1,025 resales (a deep, actionable low read; Altez 1.2 / Skysuites 1.7 next door confirm the D2 99LH cluster's weak exit record). 3) Lease: 75 yrs now, 68-71 at a 4-7 yr exit -- the next buyer is within a decade of the sub-60 CPF/bank thresholds, so the buyer pool narrows exactly when this buyer sells. 4) Yield: $6,200/mo (median of 2025-26 1,200-1,300 sqft leases) = 3.4% gross, ~2% net -- below the 3.5% fallback and no carry cushion; tenanted to Apr-27 at an unknown rent. 5) Thin format: double-volume loft, CBD investor-only demographic (9:1 leases-to-sales), HDB-upgrader share 33%, no schools within 1 km; exits go to a small pool. 6) Competing supply at the top of the precinct: Newport Residences (246u FH, $3,012-3,370 psf, 57% sold Jan-26), Skywaters (63-storey, ~2028), CBD Incentive Scheme pipeline. 7) Auction mechanics: an owner-sale 'opening price' is a floor, not a discount -- bids go up from $2.2M; with no live band bid, the fair number is at or below $2.05-2.10M (~$1,600-1,640 psf, the stack's own prints), which the seller has not signalled. 8) Mandate: CCR D2 + 2BR breaches the OCR-only, 3BR mandate for both buyers; quantum sits at her $2.2M ceiling for a unit that needs none of her $2.59M capacity. All-cash ROI 5yr 1.1%/yr (downside -0.3%, upside 2.6%). Vs the FAR 3BR ($2.82M) / Dunearn House / Union Square comparison set, this is a worse quantum-for-exit trade.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Real URA contracts for 1,200-1,300 sqft units: Mar-26 $5,700 / $6,450 / $7,000; Sep-25 $6,000 / $5,950; 2024 $6,200-6,600. Use $6,200/mo -> 3.4% gross on $2.2M, ~2% net after maintenance/tax. Project avg $6.66 psf/mo and 4.6% est yield (realsmart) apply to the small units, not this loft. Tenanted till 14 Apr 2027 (rent not disclosed) - buyer inherits ~7 months of an unknown lease.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Project is ex-growth: URA 5-yr CAGR +0.73% (137 resales), 3-yr -6.0%, 1-yr -2.5%; realsmart annual medians $1,915 (2024) -> $1,800 (2025) -> $1,760 (2026). CCR forward prior +1.9%/yr and lease decay from 75 yrs argue for 0-1.5%/yr on this stack; the loft's own prints show $1,444 (2021) -> $1,669 (2024) then nothing. Use 1.0%/yr (resale-to-resale, project-level), not the 2.8% CCR baseline.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: 1,281 sqft = 2BR+study loft with ~6m double-volume living (void in strata area); 3 prints all-time at this size, plus 1,173-1,238 sqft variants. Two linear blocks (41 & 46 storeys) face N/S; sea view claimed for #38 but unverified - no profile. Small 2BRs (904-936 sqft) are the liquid format here at $1,890-2,090 psf.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale-to-resale: project 5-yr CAGR 0.73% (137 txns), 3-yr -6%; realsmart 2024->2026 medians -8%; CCR panel forward +1.9%/yr; lease at 75 yrs
